## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request is linked to an issue (`Closes #NNN` above)
- [ ] The pull request targets `develop` and is about one thing
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): ...`, `fix(scope): ...`)
- [ ] CI is green (backend tests, frontend build and tests, dependency gate)
- [ ] Schema changes are EF Core migrations generated by the tool, not hand-edited
- [ ] A changed backend DTO has its TypeScript twin updated in `src/frontend/src/app/core/models`
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and their lock files are updated in the same commit
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or this description
- [ ] Code comments are kept to a minimum; the reasoning lives in this description
